name: prompt-forge
description: Spends your Claude Code tokens where they count: moves a new task into a fresh session (a new terminal window, or its own git worktree) instead of dragging a long conversation along, and runs small, clear tasks on Sonnet.

newSession.title: Where a new task's session opens
newSession.description: auto: a tmux window, else a new terminal window, else /clear. superset: Superset terminals and workspaces when this session runs in a Superset workspace, else auto. tmux, window or clear: only that one (window uses terminalCommand when set), else /clear.

terminalCommand.title: Command that opens a terminal window
terminalCommand.description: Optional. Used for new terminal windows instead of the system default; claude and your prompt are appended, and {dir} becomes the session's folder. Examples: ghostty --working-directory={dir} -e, kitty --directory {dir}, wezterm start --cwd {dir} --

freshMinTokens.title: Conversation size before a fresh session is offered (tokens)
freshMinTokens.description: Counted above the fixed system prompt and tools. Lower asks sooner; higher asks only in very long sessions.
